summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a press release on routine progress of its previously announced share buy-back program. The company repurchased 106,794 shares in the 12-16 October 2026 window via Nasdaq at an average of EUR 7.24, totaling EUR 772,705, under a discretionary mandate capped at EUR 30 million. Cumulative buybacks since 26 January 2026 total 1,732,815 shares for EUR 9,747,877, or 2.9% of shares outstanding. No premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics beyond weekly disclosure; this is ordinary capital-return housekeeping, not a special situation.
